# LDS Robotics UI AI entrypoint

Package: @lk-design-system/lds-robotics-ui
Layer: robotics

Component replacement alone is not LDS adoption completion.

Before implementation:

1. Read `AGENTS.md`.
2. Read `docs/package/adoption-workflow.md` and the machine contract at `docs/package/adoption-checklist.json`.
3. Read `docs/package/domain/ROBOTICS_UI_ADOPTION.md` and every applicable Robotics domain contract linked there.
4. For an existing-surface migration use `full-surface` unless the requested incremental boundary is explicitly documented.
5. Complete all six non-component facet decisions plus component mapping with typed evidence.

Installed-package entrypoints:

- `@lk-design-system/lds-robotics-ui/llms.txt`
- `@lk-design-system/lds-robotics-ui/design-system.json`
- `@lk-design-system/lds-robotics-ui/adoption-checklist.json`
- `@lk-design-system/lds-robotics-ui/docs/adoption-report.schema.json`
- `@lk-design-system/lds-robotics-ui/docs/domain/ROBOTICS_UI_ADOPTION.md`

Robotics owns DOM, SVG, editor, 2D viewer, telemetry, navigation presentation, projection helpers, and domain semantics. It does not own transport, TF authority, localization, safety decisions, WebGL/Three/R3F lifecycle, or product orchestration.

The generated `docs/package/` tree is read-only. Update authored Robotics documents or the pinned upstream snapshot, regenerate, and run `npm run check:docs`.
